purpose: Resolve the independently attested control-host primary-route contract blocker for PC-CROP #3785 using the deployed application's permanent redirect contract, exact OCI revision binding, value-free public acceptance evidence and bounded authenticated rollback without exposing production topology.
requiredInvariants: The repair remains exact-main, canonical-DNS, absent-AAAA, pinned-SSH, owner-authorized and concurrency-guarded.

When the primary-host route has one or more dials, selection requires exactly one dial in the intersection of that route and the running-web shared-network identity set; unrelated primary-host backend dials may coexist.

The legacy PRIMARY_HOST_MATCH mode is retained only for one primary-host dial whose web-bound intersection is also exactly one; multiple primary-host dials with exactly one web-bound member use UNIQUE_PRIMARY_WEB_BOUND_UPSTREAM.

A global fallback is permitted only when the exact-primary-host match count is zero and exactly one well-formed Caddy reverse-proxy dial is a per-network DNS alias of the single running Compose web container on a Docker network shared with Caddy.

Zero or multiple primary-host web-bound intersections, a global fallback with zero or multiple web-bound dials, a network-unrelated alias, or any selected dial that is not web-bound must fail before backup or mutation.
Unrelated Caddy upstreams may coexist but no upstream value, alias, network, container ID, working path or secret may reach Actions output, artifacts, summaries or issue comments.

Readiness may publish only validated numeric cardinalities or UNKNOWN for exact matches, dial format, network intersection, alias binding and current-IP binding; it must never publish the underlying values.
An already-enabled control route may return no-op success only when its persistent Compose wiring and sole marked reverse_proxy dial are revalidated against the newly selected current web upstream.
The original production Compose files remain unedited; the previously authorized fixed additive override is the only permitted gate-wiring repair.

The current immutable web image ID and exact OCI revision f1f2a094e78bf9949ca35883c627a7ed5ce70086 remain unchanged; only web may be recreated and every non-web container ID, including Caddy, remains unchanged.
Candidate Compose and Caddy configuration validate before mutation; internal and external rollback semantics remain unchanged.

Candidate Caddy validation streams the candidate through stdin to a validation process in the existing Caddy container with its current environment and read-only configuration mounts; it writes no candidate into the live mount and performs no reload.

Every public-acceptance round persists only normalized HTTP status codes, bounded redirect and exact-revision classifications, plus the first bounded failed-check name; certificate details, response bodies, headers, URLs, topology and secrets stay outside the uploaded artifact.

Any nonzero curl exit status normalizes to status 000 and fails closed even when curl emitted an HTTP code or partial response; the ten-round criteria and every existing route-isolation assertion remain unchanged or stricter.

The deployed application source at the exact OCI revision permanently redirects the primary root to /platform-v7; acceptance therefore requires an exact HTTP 308, exactly one Location header whose value case-sensitively equals /platform-v7 or the exact canonical absolute URL, a bounded PLATFORM_V7 target classification, and a direct primary /platform-v7 HTTP 200.

No nonexistent public version endpoint is treated as revision evidence; exact revision acceptance is bound to the selected running Web container OCI label and the fixed deployed application revision before public probing.

Authenticated rollback emits only a bounded stage enum, restores the original Caddy and environment state before recreating web, and allows sixty direct primary /platform-v7 checks with a five-second transfer cap inside a sixty-minute job without weakening the required final HTTP 200 result.
Ten consecutive public acceptance rounds remain mandatory before success is published.
GO remains forbidden until reviewer MFA, First Customer and all 9 of 9 role journeys pass.
acceptance: Workflow YAML and all embedded remote Bash scripts parse before merge.

The candidate validator uses caddy validate with stdin, the explicit caddyfile adapter and /etc/caddy as its working directory so existing imports and environment substitutions are evaluated without a production config write.

Static workflow checks prove every curl-derived status is normalized before evidence or assertion, the failure artifact contains only an approved bounded enum, and a transport failure cannot satisfy a deny-route assertion.

Static workflow checks prove the exact deployed root source contains permanentRedirect('/platform-v7'), primary root is accepted only as 308 with exactly one case-sensitive canonical Location value classified as PLATFORM_V7, and direct primary /platform-v7 must return HTTP 200.

Static workflow checks prove no /version.json probe remains, exact OCI revision equality is mandatory, and rollback records INPUT, remote restore, web verification and primary-health stages without publishing protected values while still requiring direct primary /platform-v7 HTTP 200.

Static positive and negative fixtures prove a primary route with one web dial plus unrelated backend dials selects only the web-bound intersection, while zero, two, and wrong-network web-bound candidates fail closed.

A read-only readiness run publishes enough redacted cardinality evidence to distinguish exact-match ambiguity, malformed dials, absent shared networks, alias mismatch and current-IP coupling without publishing topology.
Read-only readiness reaches a READY_*_UNIQUE_PRIMARY_WEB_BOUND_UPSTREAM_BEFORE_BACKUP or READY_*_UNIQUE_WEB_BOUND_UPSTREAM_BEFORE_BACKUP state without publishing topology.

The guarded cutover reports PRIMARY_HOST_MATCH, UNIQUE_PRIMARY_WEB_BOUND_UPSTREAM or UNIQUE_WEB_BOUND_UPSTREAM and passes TLS, control-login, host-isolation, parent redirect, API denial, exact-revision and primary-domain checks for 10 of 10 rounds.
Any pre-acceptance failure is either no-mutation or internally rolled back; any public-acceptance failure invokes the authenticated external rollback.
